content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for AIIMS Bhubaneswar Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for AIIMS Bhubaneswar?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the AIIMS Bhubaneswar recruitment is scheduled for 18 September 2026. Candidates should report within the specified time.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts announced by AIIMS Bhubaneswar?
faq.answer: AIIMS Bhubaneswar has announced vacancies for Project Research Scientist I, Project Nurse III, and Project Technical Support II posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for Project Research Scientist I?
faq.answer: For Project Research Scientist I, a Post Graduate Degree in Microbiology/Medical microbiology/Public Health is required. Integrated PG degrees are also accepted.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for Project Nurse III?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Nurse III position is 30 years, with age relaxation applicable as per government rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for Project Technical Support II?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Technical Support II post will receive a salary of Rs. 20,000 plus 20% HRA.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee for these positions.

faq.question: Q7. What documents are required for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring original certificates for qualification and experience, along with a set of self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for these temporary posts will be based on a Walk-In-Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at the UG Practical Hall (Microbiology), 2nd Floor, AIIMS Bhubaneswar.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, these are temporary contractual posts for an ICMR-funded project.
